end.summary:
Reyansh practised top, front and side views of cones, cylinders and cubes.
They matched views to objects in all 4 recorded attempts.
They gave 3 unaided correct responses out of 4 when describing solid views.
They practised why an object can look different from different places; the handle-view mix-up remained at the last check.
Teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Reyansh practised identifying top, front and side views using circles, triangles and rectangles, and used the method of checking the shape from each viewing place. They correctly matched all recorded views to objects and corrected their first answer about seeing a handle from the opposite side, though the final explanation still mixed up what is visible from each place. At home, place a cup or box on a table and ask Reyansh to draw its top, front and side views, focusing only on what can be seen from that position.
